foundation: Barrot V3 execution, orchestration, safety and verification

primary_source.authority: Issuer-filed SEC registration statement; primary disclosure, not independent assurance.

source_receipt.normalized_evidence: The S-1 separates cash proceeds, in-kind XRP, related-party credit, notes and contingent equity. It reports $214.1M historical cash used to buy 84.365876M XRP; 388.910554M XRP contributed in kind; $272.6M gross cash at close; $30M notes received Oct 12; a $10M Ripple Company Facility with $9.7M drawn Oct 7; a separate $1M Evernorth Facility undrawn as of June 30; a conditional Cantor ELOC with no proceeds; SBI-group holdings and voting restrictions; Coinbase as principal market for accounting; BitGo Trust as initial custodian; and disclosed XRP liquidity/collateral limitations.
source_receipt.short_exact_quote: The Company’s primary source of liquidity will be loans and XRP contributed from Ripple.
source_receipt.receipt_scope: Hash binds the normalized evidence summary above, not the complete SEC filing bytes.

entity_map.operating_company: Pathfinder Digital Assets LLC, referred to as the Company in the filing.
entity_map.ripple: Ripple Labs Inc. — related-party lender, XRP contributor and holder of Company Units.
entity_map.sbi_parent: SBI Holdings, Inc. — parent/controller of four SBI Stockholders; not SBIC East/Central/West.
entity_map.note_purchaser: NH Investment & Securities Co., as trustee of Kyobo AIM Corporate Finance General Private Investment Trust No. 3.
entity_map.primary_xrp_custodian: BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association (formerly BitGo Trust Company, Inc.)

private_placement_cash.expenses_status: Before transaction expenses; not a net-cash figure.

historical_xrp_purchase.classification: Historical cash-funded XRP purchases disclosed by issuer; not current-period flow.

in_kind_xrp_contributions.classification: Non-cash XRP contributions; do not classify as cash raised or open-market purchases.

holdings_reconciliation.note: The approximate 473M reported holding reconciles to the disclosed purchased and in-kind XRP components within rounding.

convertible_notes.purchaser: NH Investment & Securities Co., trustee of Kyobo AIM Corporate Finance General Private Investment Trust No. 3
convertible_notes.use_of_proceeds: General corporate purposes, including potential XRP acquisition and XRP ecosystem activities.
convertible_notes.xrp_purchase_evidence: No evidence in this filing that the note proceeds had been used to purchase XRP.

ripple_company_facility.borrower: Pathfinder Digital Assets LLC (the Company), not Evernorth directly.
ripple_company_facility.repayment_terms: Repayable within five business days after closing or following the contractual demand/notice mechanism.
ripple_company_facility.use_and_reclassification: Certain Ripple payments to third parties on behalf of the Company and Evernorth, previously recorded as related-party payables, were treated as borrowings.
ripple_company_facility.classification: Related-party debt, not equity, not cash subscription proceeds, and not proof of XRP purchases.

ripple_evernorth_facility.classification: Separate Evernorth facility; June 30 undrawn status must not be projected forward as a current balance.

cantor_committed_equity_facility.fee_status: Payable after registration effectiveness; fully earned and non-refundable once paid, even if no purchases occur.
cantor_committed_equity_facility.classification: Conditional potential future equity financing, not actual capital received as of the prospectus.

sbi_holdings_ownership.class_c_voting_status: Non-voting except as required by Nevada law; retains economic rights.
sbi_holdings_ownership.voting_and_dispositive_control: The filing says decisions are made by the SBI board on management recommendation by majority vote; no individual board member acting alone has voting or dispositive power.
sbi_holdings_ownership.individual_cash_xrp_subscription_split: Not separately disclosed in the retrieved filing. Aggregate advance-funding cash/XRP must not be attributed entirely to SBI.
sbi_holdings_ownership.identity_resolution: This is SBI Holdings, Inc. and four controlled investment entities. It is not SBIC East Japan, SBIC Central Japan or SBIC West Japan.

ripple_relationship.consideration: 16,461,545 Company Units issued by Pathfinder to Ripple.
ripple_relationship.classification: Related-party contribution and equity/unit interests; not cash purchases.

liquidity_and_financial_condition.revenue_status: No revenue reported as of the October 30, 2026 prospectus.
liquidity_and_financial_condition.date_caveat: These June 30 balances precede the October 9 business-combination closing and October 12 notes. They are not current post-closing cash or working-capital balances.

custody_accounting_and_collateral.custodian: BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, formerly BitGo Trust Company, Inc.
custody_accounting_and_collateral.custody_status_as_of_prospectus: All XRP held through BitGo; 100% in offline/cold storage as of the prospectus date.
custody_accounting_and_collateral.custodian_status: OCC-chartered non-depository public trust company; issuer describes it as a qualified custodian.

insurance.caveat: Coverage is shared among BitGo clients and subject to policy limits, deductibles and allocation; not a dedicated $250M Evernorth policy.

custody_accounting_and_collateral.segregation_and_rehypothecation: The filing describes segregated custody accounts and states BitGo may not pledge, lend or otherwise use the XRP unless expressly directed as part of yield strategies.
custody_accounting_and_collateral.accounting: Indefinite-lived intangible asset at cost less impairment; impairment considers the lowest observable intraday price since acquisition.

coinbase_principal_market.purpose: Principal market for financial reporting and impairment measurement.
coinbase_principal_market.inference_prohibited: This does not prove Coinbase executed Evernorth purchases, is Evernorth's custodian, or that current XRP market volume is concentrated there.

custody_accounting_and_collateral.collateral_and_liquidity_risk: The filing warns XRP may be less liquid than cash and may not be available as a liquidity source or usable to collateralize loans/bonds during market instability or significant price declines.

exact_phrase_research.result: The filing does not use the exact phrase in the reviewed sections. It does provide a primary-source capital stack that separates cash, in-kind XRP, related-party debt, convertible notes and conditional equity.

interpretation.primary_conclusion: Evernorth's XRP position is a mixture of historical cash purchases and large in-kind contributions. Ripple is both an XRP contributor and related-party credit provider. SBI Holdings is a major shareholder through four controlled entities, but its individual cash/XRP subscription split is not disclosed. Coinbase is selected as accounting principal market; BitGo is the actual disclosed custodian.
counter_hypotheses: Ripple facilities may be ordinary contractual liquidity support rather than evidence of distress.
June 30 cash/working-capital deficits predate the October closing and $30M notes; they must not be represented as post-closing balances.
The $30M notes are cash financing but the filing does not prove the proceeds purchased XRP.
The Cantor ELOC is conditional and unfunded as of the prospectus date.
prohibited_inferences: Do not attribute the entire $214.05M advance-funding cash to SBI.
Do not count 388.910554M in-kind XRP as cash or market purchases.
Do not count the $9.7M Company Facility as Evernorth equity or as XRP demand.
Do not count the ELOC as capital received.
Do not treat Coinbase's principal-market designation as a trading-volume or custody claim.
Do not treat BitGo's shared insurance as dedicated coverage.

model_eligibility.reason: Corporate capital and custody disclosures are contextual event features only after point-in-time availability, issuer-vintage controls and independent evaluation are implemented.
